title: Each review Round line names the head it read, and the record tool refuses a mismatch
why: Coordinator 23:34 CST Nov 8: four lanes tonight posted records whose round 3 read an older head than the record's Head line (#2379, #2371, #2388, #2385). On #2388 the rounds read the replaced PR's head (#2362, 98d2b4eee) and the coordinator caught it by hand at 23:28 CST. The tool cannot see which head a round read. Harm: a merge on rounds that never read the merged code.
note: Fix: each Round line carries the head it read, and `merge --review-record` refuses a record whose last round or fix check names a head other than --head. Lane agent-worktree-add-in-tool-dir also proposed refusing a record on a PR whose earlier head sits in a replaced PR without a round dated after the head commit. Starts after record-tool-posts-itself merges; may fold into fix-check-record-carries-rounds if one lane takes both.
